title: Mizumi's High Fantasy
description: Medieval High Fantasy Classic RPG modpack
body: Mizumi's High Fantasy is a medieval fantasy-themed modpack. The idea is to have a classic RPG adventure, with an attempt to create a slower progression so you don't become overpowered too early. Choose classes and improve your attributes, evolve your character and conquer lands and defeat powerful enemies, fall in love and create a family, protect your village or kingdom, or you can be the one who causes chaos wherever you go. The choice is yours. So, can you face this world?
